title: STEW profile
description: A harness profile (a 'hat'): what an agent may do for one task family, within which budgets, behind which gates, and how done is checked. spec/profile.md.

version.description: An integer; any change to the profile is a new version.

for.description: The task family, in words, and the capability ids it serves.

tools.description: The allow-list: exact tool names. Nothing else is offered. An empty list holds no tools. Reach is derived from these tools, never asserted.

instructions.description: At most 8 lines added to the agent's standing instructions for this task. Names only tools in `tools`.

budgets.description: Upper bounds the runtime enforces. An absent budget means the runtime's own default, never unlimited.

reads.description: Reads (file, note, search) before the plan card.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls in the whole run.

wall_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds for the whole run.

output_tokens.description: Model output tokens for the whole run.

reasoning.description: The model's reasoning effort, where the model offers one.

model.description: Optional: the model this profile was measured on, as the runtime names it (for example an Ollama tag). The runtime maps it; a declaration never names a host.

gates.description: The runtime's standing bounds this task touches (all are always on; naming them is for the card and the cases), and extra refusals this profile adds. A profile can add a refusal, never remove one.

card.description: Human approval: plan = one card showing the plan and this profile before any write; every-write = a card on each write as well; none = a read or a refusal, no card.

success.description: The deterministic check that says the task is done: a check name the runtime's eval kit knows, with optional arguments.

summary.description: The one line sent to the human at the end. <placeholders> are filled by the runtime.
